text: 纳斯达克金龙中国指数收涨2.51%，报6257.87点，逼近50日均线（该技术指标目前下移至6294.47点）。 ETF中，中概互联网指数ETF（KWEB）收涨2.70%，中国科技指数ETF（CQQQ）收涨2.43%。 XtrackersHarvest中证50（ASHS）收涨2.03%，德银嘉实沪深300指数ETF（ASHR）收涨1.19%，MSCI新兴市场ex中国ETF（EMXC）收跌0.21%。
text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed up 2.51% at 6,257.87 points, approaching its 50-day moving average (currently declining to 6,294.47 points). Among ETFs, the KraneShares CSI China Internet ETF (KWEB) closed up 2.70%, the China Technology Index ETF (CQQQ) closed up 2.43%, the Xtrackers Harvest CSI 500 China A-Shares ETF (ASHS) closed up 2.03%, the Deutsche X-trackers Harvest CSI 300 Index ETF (ASHR) closed up 1.19%, and the iShares MSCI Emerging Markets ex China ETF (EMXC) closed down 0.21%.
